name: Proto Part Inc.
old_description: All tooling is created in-house, & we can run plastic parts from hundreds to hundreds of thousands.
about:
Proto Part Inc. operates from Hudson, New Hampshire, where it has been producing thermoplastic injection molded parts for over 25 years. The company emphasizes American manufacturing and win-win relationships, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in thermoplastic injection molding with all tooling built in-house. Capabilities include insert molding, family molding, and design-for-manufacturability support, running on horizontal and vertical presses ranging from 28 to 310 clamping tons with shot sizes of 1 to 25 ounces. Processes follow scientific injection molding and decoupled molding principles, with ongoing automation investments to increase efficiency. Production volumes span from hundreds to hundreds of thousands of parts per run, covering both mid- and high-volume orders.

Proto Part serves medical, defense, safety, electronic/electrical, industrial, aerospace, solar, and automotive markets, as well as niche consumer products such as cribbage pegs, golf tees, tape containers, and archery bowstring spools. Long-term customers include Semiconductor Circuits Inc., Road Tools LLC, Mirror Tee, RF Hunter, and Wall Industries, with relationships exceeding 20 years in some cases.

The company cites complete customer satisfaction as its founding principle, differentiating itself through in-house tooling, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and a commitment to better communication and total transparency. Engineers assist with part design to meet structural requirements, and the firm promotes creative, economical, and quick solutions for custom plastic components.
